description_zh: 重型卡车（ego）在左侧车道直行，Waymo AV（NPC）从右侧相邻车道切入，导致卡车右前侧与AV左后侧碰撞。选择卡车为ego以测试其对侧方车辆切入的反应能力。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was in autonomous mode traveling north in the rightmost of two lanes on Van Ness Avenue when it partially entered the left adjacent lane to make room for a cyclist on its right who was traveling in the same direction.

A heavy truck behind in the left adjacent lane proceeded forward, and the Waymo AV test driver transitioned to manual mode immediately before the rear driver side of the Waymo AV made contact with the front passenger side of the heavy truck.
evidence.reason: 双方均为移动车辆，存在交互碰撞。AV变道切入卡车车道，卡车直行，符合cut_in场景。无量化参数，使用默认值。
